contexts.text: The sadness here signified by to weep, does not mean sadness on account of death in the internal sense as in the external; but on account of the good of the Spiritual Church, in that it cannot be elevated above what is natural.
When the Angels are in the last state, which is when they are in their proprium, they begin to become sad. I have spoken with them when they were in this state, and have seen their sadness...
The Angels are in sadness on account of the darkness on the Earth.
In those (spheres of consociations) in which they cannot be, they fall into sadness.
I heard one (on that mountain of the celestials) saying that he was in a sad state. Explained. SE 5127.
